```{r}
# app.R
# app.R

library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(plotly)


# =========================================
url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/greggmaloy/608/refs/heads/main/assignment_5_temp.csv"
df <- read.csv(url, check.names = TRUE)

# Rename LOWESS column if needed
if ("Lowess.30." %in% names(df)) {
  names(df)[names(df) == "Lowess.30."] <- "Lowess_30"
}

# Internal name -> pretty name map
series_map <- c(
  No_Smoothing = "No smoothing",
  Lowess_30    = "LOWESS (30-year)"
)

# Keep only series that actually exist
series_map <- series_map[names(series_map) %in% names(df)]

# Color map for the visible lines
color_map <- c(
  "No smoothing"      = "black",
  "LOWESS (30-year)"  = "red"
)

year_min <- min(df$Year, na.rm = TRUE)
year_max <- max(df$Year, na.rm = TRUE)

# =========================================
# UI
# =========================================
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Global Temperature Anomalies – Shiny + Plotly"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      h4("Controls"),
      
      sliderInput(
        "yearRange",
        "Year range:",
        min = year_min,
        max = year_max,
        value = c(year_min, year_max),
        step = 1,
        sep = ""
      ),
      
      checkboxGroupInput(
        "series",
        "Series to display:",
        choices = setNames(names(series_map), series_map),
        selected = names(series_map)
      ),
      
      checkboxInput(
        "showTrend",
        "Show linear trend for No_Smoothing",
        value = TRUE
      ),
      
      hr(),
      helpText("Hover over the lines to see exact values. ",
               "Use the controls to change the time window and series.")
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      plotlyOutput("tempPlot", height = "450px"),
      br(),
      verbatimTextOutput("statsText")
    )
  )
)

# =========================================
# SERVER
# =========================================
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  # Filter based on year range
  filtered_data <- reactive({
    df %>%
      filter(Year >= input$yearRange[1],
             Year <= input$yearRange[2])
  })
  
  # Plotly line plot with correct colors
  output$tempPlot <- renderPlotly({
    dat <- filtered_data()
    req(length(input$series) > 0)
    
    p <- plot_ly(dat, x = ~Year)
    
    # Add one trace per selected series
    for (colname in input$series) {
      pretty <- series_map[[colname]]
      line_color <- color_map[[pretty]]
      
      p <- p %>%
        add_lines(
          y = dat[[colname]],
          name = pretty,
          line = list(color = line_color, width = 2),
          hovertemplate = paste0(
            "Series: ", pretty, "<br>",
            "Year: %{x}<br>",
            "Temp: %{y:.3f} °C",
            "<extra></extra>"
          )
        )
    }
    
    # Add GRAY trend line (dashed)
    if (input$showTrend && "No_Smoothing" %in% input$series && "No_Smoothing" %in% names(dat)) {
      ns_data <- dat %>% select(Year, No_Smoothing) %>% drop_na()
      
      if (nrow(ns_data) >= 2) {
        fit <- lm(No_Smoothing ~ Year, data = ns_data)
        ns_data$Trend <- predict(fit, newdata = ns_data)
        
        p <- p %>%
          add_lines(
            data = ns_data,
            x = ~Year,
            y = ~Trend,
            name = "Linear trend",
            line = list(
              color = "#D3D3D3",   # gray
              dash = "dash",
              width = 3
            ),
            hovertemplate = paste0(
              "Series: Linear trend<br>",
              "Year: %{x}<br>",
              "Trend: %{y:.3f} °C",
              "<extra></extra>"
            )
          )
      }
    }
    
    p %>%
      layout(
        title = "Global Temperature Anomalies",
        xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
        yaxis = list(title = "Temperature Anomaly (°C)"),
        legend = list(title = list(text = "Series"))
      )
  })
  
  # Stats for No_Smoothing
  output$statsText <- renderText({
    dat <- filtered_data()
    
    if (!"No_Smoothing" %in% names(dat)) {
      return("No_Smoothing series not found in dataset.")
    }
    
    dat_ns <- dat %>% select(Year, No_Smoothing) %>% drop_na()
    if (nrow(dat_ns) < 2) return("Not enough data to compute statistics.")
    
    fit <- lm(No_Smoothing ~ Year, data = dat_ns)
    
    slope <- coef(fit)[["Year"]]
    avg   <- mean(dat_ns$No_Smoothing)
    med   <- median(dat_ns$No_Smoothing)
    
    paste0(
      "Statistics for No_Smoothing (", input$yearRange[1], "–", input$yearRange[2], "):\n",
      sprintf("  Slope: %+0.3f °C/year\n", slope),
      sprintf("  Average anomaly: %0.3f °C\n", avg),
      sprintf("  Median anomaly:  %0.3f °C", med)
    )
  })
}

# =========================================
# RUN APP
# =========================================
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)



```
